title: An email to a friend
summary_es: Un correo para organizar una visita. Preposiciones, «there is», preguntas y pronombres.
text: Hi Sam, Thanks {{1}} your email. I'm very happy that you can come to visit me next month. My flat is small, but {{2}} is a sofa bed in the living room. What time {{3}} your train arrive? I can meet you {{4}} the station. On Saturday we can go to the beach if the weather {{5}} good. Do you like fish? There is a very good restaurant near my flat. Write soon and tell {{6}} what you want to do! Love, Kate

gaps.explanation_es: «Thanks for» + nombre o -ing: thanks for your email, thanks for coming.
«There is» = hay (singular). «It is» no sirve para decir que algo existe.
Pregunta en presente simple con horarios: What time does the train arrive? Con «will» también es correcta.
Punto de encuentro: at the station.
Tras «if» va presente aunque hablemos del futuro: if the weather is good (no «will be»).
«Tell» necesita la persona: tell me. (Con «say» sería say to me.)
